question: What political position does Kuvāca gain after obtaining that support?
premises: He becomes a sharer in rule.
The rule is described as his own kingdom.
inference: Having obtained that support, Kuvāca becomes a sharer in his own kingdom.
uncertainties: svīyarājyabhāk may imply sharing rule in his own realm or regaining a share of it.
plain_english: Having obtained that help, Kuvāca becomes a sharer in his own kingdom.
